newsitem.title: UK: Dixons up again on positive results comment.
newsitem.headline: Dixons up again on positive results comment.

text.p: Shares in Dixons Group Plc firmed in pre-market trade on Thursday, adding to Wednesday's sharp gains amid positive press comment on the company's results.
In a mostly lower market, the stock was up 4-1/2p at 541 by 0728 GMT in volume of 81,000 shares.

The Financial Times Lex column highlighted Dixons' 17 percent rise in same store sales and said the stock "looks set for a further leg-up", while the Tempus column in the Times said the stock's in-line rating was "ridiculous" given its growth rate.
Dixons on Wednesday posted a 41 percent rise in pre-tax profit before one-off items to 190.2 million stg for the year ended May 3, sparking a round of upgrades to analysts' profit forecasts.
